question:
**Direction: Improve the underlined part of the sentence. Choose 'No improvement' as an answer if the sentence is grammatically correct.**

The rise in temperature __**disturbs the rain cycle**.__
solution:
The correct answer is **'No improvement.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is grammatically correct.
 
• The verb **'disturbs'** is in the present tense and matches with the subject **'rise in temperature'.**
 
• **'Rain cycle'** is a common term used to refer to the process of rainfall in a particular area.
 
• The sentence talks about how the rise in temperature affects the rain cycle, indicating a cause-effect relationship between the two. 

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1: Uses past tense** 'was disturbed'** which does not match with the present tense subject **'rise in temperature'.**
 
• Option 2: Uses an incorrect adjective** 'rainy' **instead of the noun **'rain'.**
 
• Option 4: Uses present participle form **'disturbing'** which does not match with the subject **'rise in temperature'.**
